description: Generate a one-time embedded signing URL for a specific signer in an Etch packet (for iframe/redirect signing flows). GraphQL mutation: generateEtchSignURL. Returns { url }.

client_user_id.description: Your app's stable id for the signing user (ties the session to your user).

signer_eid.description: The signer eid (from the packet's documentGroup.signers).

name: anvil_generate_etch_sign_url
title: Generate Etch signing URL
